svg.title: WP4 Testing psychological information in human–AI interaction
svg.desc: Layout-only refinement of the manually edited boxed WP4 figure. All five psychological-information conditions, participant portrait, randomization branches and target allocations remain unchanged. Their convergence is connected to the existing circular illustration of a woman interacting with a chatbot. A thin branching arrow connects that interaction to the original helpfulness, feeling-understood and mood-change icons, each aligned with its existing label. The unchanged longitudinal schedule is relocated beneath the interaction and outcome region: opening 60 minutes, four 30-minute conversations over two weeks in the same assigned arm, closing 60 minutes. The canvas is cropped vertically; artwork, text content and type sizes are not regenerated or enlarged. The manually edited V3 remains untouched.

g.desc: Three illustrative WildChat user-language trajectories in a PCA fitted to 278,449 windows from 1,482 complete conversations. Colors identify users; opacity increases from start to end. Depression and Emotional Wellbeing arrows show the projections of their linear-probe readout axes into this PCA, with a common display scale. These language signals are not measured psychological states.
